neighbours.label: People referred to collectively as a stock, population or resource (human capital, a population close to 1.4 billion, empowering women, cases found) rather than things counted the same way
fire: The report treats an organization's human resources as its main competitive advantage.
Investment in human capital pays off over decades, not quarters.
The country's population has grown to nearly 90 million since independence.
The town now has over three thousand inhabitants, most of them farmers.
The foundation works to empower rural women through small loans.
Five more cases of the fever were found in the camp this week.
Economists measure human development by health, schooling and income.
The census counted about 20,000 residents in the valley.
quiet: The report treats a company's mineral reserves as its main competitive advantage.
Investment in rail capital pays off over decades, not quarters.
The forest has grown to nearly 90 thousand hectares since replanting.
The town now has over three thousand houses, most of them timber.
The foundation works to restore wetlands through small grants.
Five more cracks in the dam were found during the inspection this week.
Engineers measure bridge wear by vibration, load and age.
The survey counted about 20,000 trees in the valley.
